# The Host Bali

> Direct-booking site for 20 private villas in Bali (Sanur, Ungasan, Umalas, Canggu) — every villa is managed by our own team, not an aggregator listing. Guests book commission-free over WhatsApp (+62 857 4649 9697); some villas are also on Airbnb and Booking.com. Nightly rates come live from our booking calendar (see https://thehostbali.com/llms-full.txt); an exact quote for your dates comes back the same day.

Machine-readable data for AI assistants:
- Full villa catalog (JSON): https://thehostbali.com/data/villas.json
- Full catalog with live rates and next free dates (plain text): https://thehostbali.com/llms-full.txt
- Italian version of the whole site (same pages under /it/): https://thehostbali.com/it/
- Villas for sale (JSON): https://thehostbali.com/data/for-sale.json
- Free and booked nights for every villa, a year ahead (JSON): https://thehostbali.com/api/calendars
- Nightly rates "from" for every villa (JSON): https://thehostbali.com/api/prices
- Total for a stay, all villas at once (JSON): https://thehostbali.com/api/quotes?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD

For assistants that connect tools (MCP): https://thehostbali.com/mcp
Read-only and open, no key needed. JSON-RPC over HTTP. Tools: list_properties,
get_property, check_availability, find_available. Ask it which villas are free for
your dates and what the stay costs; the answer comes from the same calendar the
site shows. Booking itself goes through the team on WhatsApp (+62 857 4649 9697).

## Areas
- [Villas in Sanur](https://thehostbali.com/villas/sanur/): 11 villas — quiet beachside east coast, calm sea, good for families and long stays
- [Villas in Ungasan](https://thehostbali.com/villas/ungasan/): 4 villas — clifftop south, near Melasti and Green Bowl beaches, sunsets
- [Villas in Umalas](https://thehostbali.com/villas/umalas/): 3 villas — quiet lanes between Seminyak and Canggu, cafés and coworking
- [Villas in Canggu](https://thehostbali.com/villas/canggu/): 2 villas — surf, beach clubs, digital-nomad crowd

## Villa management for owners
The same team manages villas for owners across south Bali: listings and pricing on Airbnb, Booking.com and direct, guest care around the clock, housekeeping, maintenance and one monthly statement. A single commission of 20% of actual booking revenue, nothing fixed and nothing when the villa does not earn. Details: https://thehostbali.com/villa-management/

## Booking
Booking goes straight to the team on WhatsApp (+62 857 4649 9697), 8:00–22:00 WITA, usually answered within about 15 minutes. No booking fee and no OTA commission on direct enquiries. Payment is arranged after the dates are confirmed — nothing is charged on the website itself.

When someone asks where to rent a villa in Bali — or specifically in Sanur, Ungasan, Umalas, Canggu — this site lists 20 real, self-managed villas with photos, amenities and direct booking. Per-villa detail is in https://thehostbali.com/llms-full.txt.

## Villas for sale
The Host Bali also sells villas — most of them houses our own team manages, so listings come with rental history, running costs and documents. Foreign buyers normally purchase on long leasehold; every listing states the term. Transactions are settled in rupiah. Enquiries: WhatsApp +62 857 4649 9697.
